field.label: Enable daily check
field.comment: Once a day, by cron, the module looks up your Magento version and the Composer packages in composer.lock against security advisories (Packagist and CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, by default through Valtry's Advisory API). Only package names leave your server, never versions; the matching happens here. No store URL, no customer data, no keys.

field.label: Notification emails
field.comment: Comma-separated. Leave empty to see alerts in the admin only. Email is sent once per new finding, and again if it becomes exploited.

field.label: Minimum severity to email
field.comment: Exploited vulnerabilities are always emailed. Advisories Packagist has not rated count as High.

field.label: Advisory source
field.comment: Valtry (default) asks Valtry's Advisory API, which serves the same Packagist, OSV and CISA data from one request. It receives package names only, never versions, and every answer is signed and verified here. If Valtry is unreachable, slow or answers wrongly, the public feeds are used automatically. Public feeds only never contacts Valtry: the module asks Packagist and CISA directly. Setting the environment variable RUVELO_ADVISORIES_SOURCE=public does the same and wins over this setting.
